task: E13 PO handoff proof adapter ownership alignment under quality knowledge; no runtime behavior changes.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: The change updates an exact-head browser proof adapter and its canonical Atlas ownership only. It must follow the already-verified workforce entry contract without changing product runtime behavior, and must not let proof infrastructure remain unowned or silently stale.

acceptanceCriteria: E13 product-owner handoff navigates directly to the canonical workforce entry route with next=/admin/platform instead of relying on the legacy /platform password surface.
The handoff locates and submits the canonical workforce-auth form rather than legacy PlatformAuthForm labels/selectors.
No product runtime authentication, authorization, tenant, storefront, builder or admin implementation file changes in this transaction.
Release Risk Budget remains within the canonical limit as an isolated quality-infrastructure change.
invariants: The merged Workforce Auth Core remains read-only.
The E13 harness is proof infrastructure, not a second authentication authority.
DOMAIN-QUALITY owns the proof adapter; product domains remain consumers/subjects of proof only.
PR #858 remains parked and AAL2 enforcement is not activated.
The delegator release remains separate and is not merged as part of this transaction.

failureModes: E13 still opens /platform and waits for a login UI that the runtime convergence removes.
E13 reaches canonical workforce entry but still searches for legacy input/button selectors.
The proof script remains Atlas-unowned, so an isolated quality transaction cannot declare canonical authority.
The quality fix accidentally edits runtime entrypoint code and recreates the Release Risk Budget violation.
The domain registration is broadened beyond the exact proof-script family and captures unrelated scripts.
edgeCases: The workforce entry route may render before full page load; the harness waits for the canonical data-workforce-auth root.
The next target remains exact /admin/platform and is encoded by URLSearchParams rather than string concatenation.
Credentials continue to come from the existing E13 proof environment; the change does not alter secrets or identity authority.
The proof adapter remains valid even after /platform becomes a thin delegator because it no longer depends on that presentation route.
